plan.failureSummary: The page.ai deterministic cache used a stale positional CSS selector (`div:nth-of-type(2) > button`) to open the Developers menu, which now targets the Solutions menu following a navbar redesign. As a result, navigation to `/docs/` did not occur and the subsequent URL assertion failed.
observedIndicators: Cached runSource uses `#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button` for the Developers dropdown menu.
Tool execution logs show clicking on `<button class="nav-item" ...>Solutions</button>` instead of Developers due to the positional selector.
Live screenshot confirms that 'Solutions' is the 2nd item and 'Developers' is now the 3rd item in the navigation bar.
The user-authored assertion `expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/')` failed because the page stayed on `https://www.checklyhq.com/`.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the page.ai cache for checkly.test.ts so that page.ai re-resolves the 'Developers' navigation item and dropdown link against the updated navbar structure.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache and running in autonomous mode will allow the agent to correctly target the visible 'Developers' navigation button and proceed to Documentation.
